title: About Us
description_1: This project is an initiative of the University of São Paulo (USP), in development since 2020, as part of research aimed at creating innovative solutions for the evaluation of interactive systems.
description_2: Our mission is to enable a greater number of professionals from different areas to evaluate their solutions using an integrated digital environment. This environment offers diverse evaluation tools, performs automatic calculations based on predefined formulas and presents the results in a simple and intuitive way.
motivationDescription: The development of this project was driven by the need to create a digital space that:
motivationDescriptionItem_1: Provides evaluation instruments for different purposes and contexts.
motivationDescriptionItem_2: Expands the ability to evaluate different requirements, such as usability, accessibility, user experience (UX) and player experience (XP).
motivationDescriptionItem_3: Provides associated services, such as flexible templates and integration of data from sensors.
motivationDescriptionItem_4: Facilitates the use of instruments from other areas (such as Healthcare and Psychology) in digital format, with quick visualization of the results.
featuresItemDescription_1: Our framework brings together tools that are not limited to the evaluation of virtual products. We also take into account aspects related to the individual's life, such as quality of life and moods, using instruments already validated by areas such as Psychology and Gerontology.
featuresItemDescription_2: A space that allows professionals to:
featuresItemDescription_2Item_1: Evaluate solutions taking into account the context of use and the particularities of users.
featuresItemDescription_2Item_2: Create and customize instruments with flexible templates.
featuresItemDescription_2Item_3: Perform and store evaluation data in a centralized way.
featuresItemDescription_3Item_1: Microservices: Accessible tools for other systems to consume the framework's instruments.
featuresItemDescription_3Item_2: Physiological Sensors: Integration of data collected by sensors, with detailed visualization.
featuresItemDescription_3Item_3: Intuitive Analysis: Presentation of results designed to facilitate reading and interpretation.
benefitsDescription: Our framework was designed to benefit not only Computer Science professionals, but also professionals from areas such as Healthcare, Psychology and Gerontology. For example:
benefitsDescriptionItem_1: Healthcare professionals can apply instruments from their domains and quickly view the results.
benefitsDescriptionItem_2: Researchers can associate evaluations of interfaces and interactions with aspects of users' lives.
